# OULAD test sample

A small subset of the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset, used only by the tests so CI
does not download the full 46.7 MB zip. Made by `scripts/make_sample.py`: module presentations
AAA 2013J and BBB 2013J, the 40 lowest student ids in each, and all of their rows.

Source: Kuzilek, J., Hlosta, M. & Zdrahal, Z. (2015). Open University Learning Analytics Dataset.
UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5KK69. Licence: CC BY 4.0
(https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/349/open+university+learning+analytics+dataset).
Changes: rows filtered as above, no values altered.
